controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), asset() returned canonical USDx and getVaultState() reported solvent=true, assetBalance=requiredAssets=45534526553486274453968047 wei. Deposits mint pro-rata shares against USDx; requestRedeem burns shares and reserves assets; cancellation re-mints previously burned shares but cancelPaused was true. Deposit, request, servicing and claim pauses were false. Reward funding transfers USDx before vesting. The exact verified implementation has no unrestricted local share-minter role. This is mint-scoped resolution, not immutable code or absence of inherited parent issuance.

controls.evidence: Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from vault deployment block 25597991 through block 26197360 contains 17 events: the Safe is sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and RESTRICTION_ROLE holder; REWARD_MANAGER_ROLE has the Safe and 0x14de0d47605e16bd6db3a8f0f95dfb26329de38e; REDEMPTION_SERVICER_ROLE has the Safe and 0x714ed1a0ea47ba4afb59165e0a72f6c5c57646f1. Every active membership and the deployer's absence from all five roles were corroborated with hasRole. redemptionControls.serviceAuthority still names the deployer but is metadata, not an authorization check. The Safe remains 3-of-5 with an empty modules list ending at the sentinel and zero standard guard. Its fallback handler is the standard Safe 1.4.1 CompatibilityFallbackHandler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99; the parent USDx review of this same Safe at the same pin found its runtime equal to verified source, with FallbackManager calling rather than delegating to it and no persistent unquorummed execution path. Signer independence remains unverified. Non-upgrade parameter actions are immediate.

review.evidence: Fresh fixed-block reads at Ethereum 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), complete deployment-to-pin vault and timelock role histories and current hasRole calls resolve service, reward, restriction, admin and upgrade memberships. Local shares mint through asset-backed deposit accounting or restoration of a cancelled request; cancellation was paused at the pin. No unrestricted share-minter role exists in the exact verified implementation, whose runtime matches pinned deployed code. The same 3-of-5 Safe is timelock proposer/executor/canceller and directly controls vault parameters. Its nonzero fallback handler is the standard Safe CompatibilityFallbackHandler reviewed for the same Safe in the parent USDx listing, where no persistent unquorummed execution path was identified. Parent USDx retains direct Safe mint and offchain reserve-reconciliation risk. Seven-day cooldown eligibility is not guaranteed servicing completion. No independent signer or key-custody certificate is asserted. These unresolved custody questions do not erase the complete local role census.

scopedQuestions.question: Axis discloses that the governance Safe's multisig signer keys are held in cold storage on hardware wallets, with a geographically distributed 3-of-5 set inside and outside Axis Labs. What independent evidence binds the five observed signer addresses to separate operators and specifies their recovery and approval policy? Hardware-wallet custody is public but is not an MPC or HSM attestation.
